fifa-professional-2023.title: FIFA Professional Football Report 2023
fifa-professional-2023.scope: 2023 men’s professional football; national association coverage and definitions.
fifa-professional-2023.limitations: Two canonical normalized v2 datasets preserve non-null men's professional-player and professional-club counts from all 211 national pages. Missing values remain missing. Extracted national sums differ from FIFA's published global headline and are not altered. Page 38 has a KUWAIT/Kyrgyzstan identity anomaly and must not be auto-mapped.

fifa-big-count-2006.title: FIFA Big Count 2006 — All Players (archived original table)
fifa-big-count-2006.scope: 208 original table rows, association totals, registered/unregistered players, clubs and officials; raw facts in observations/fifa_big_count_2006.csv.
fifa-big-count-2006.limitations: Checked-in normalized observation v2 datasets preserve the 2006 all-player, registered, unregistered, club and officials fields without treating missing cells as zero. The legacy extract is mixed-sex, does not retain per-cell direct/statistically-processed flags, and field definitions are not assumed globally identical. Earth identity reconciliation remains a separate reviewed layer.

aiff-history.title: All India Football Federation — History
aiff-history.scope: Indian federation and national competition history.
aiff-history.limitations: Institutional history is stronger evidence for tradition/competition than national popularity/access.

caf-senegal-academies-league.title: CAF — Football academies supply Senegal's den
caf-senegal-academies-league.scope: Official CAF account: Génération Foot founded in 2000, Diambars in 2003, professional league launched in 2009, and academy-trained players represented strongly in the national team.
caf-senegal-academies-league.limitations: Academy success is evidence for development pathways; league launch is competition/elite-support evidence. Neither directly measures mass participation.

caf-south-africa.title: CAF — South Africa member association
caf-south-africa.scope: South African association history and modern affiliation context.
caf-south-africa.limitations: Association milestones alone do not quantify apartheid-era domestic participation.

fifa-senegal-generation-foot-2000.title: FIFA — Fatma Samoura and Senegalese football look to the future in Dakar
fifa-senegal-generation-foot-2000.scope: Official FIFA account stating Génération Foot was founded in 2000 and documenting its training infrastructure and player-development role.
fifa-senegal-generation-foot-2000.limitations: Academy evidence is strong for elite development but does not represent nationwide access or participation.

fifa-south-africa-history.title: FIFA historical publication — South African football and international exclusion
fifa-south-africa-history.scope: Suspension/expulsion, domestic structures and readmission context.
fifa-south-africa-history.limitations: Historical narrative; numeric ratings remain model estimates.

frmf-history.title: Royal Moroccan Football Federation — History of Moroccan football
frmf-history.limitations: Does not provide a complete annual participation series.

jfa-history.title: Japan Football Association — History
jfa-history.scope: JFA institutional, competition and professionalisation milestones.
jfa-history.limitations: Milestones do not directly measure the six ratings.

uefa-czechia-history.title: UEFA — Developing football in Czechia
uefa-czechia-history.scope: Czech football association roots, Czech/Czechoslovak timeline, post-1993 competition and development context.
uefa-czechia-history.limitations: Czechoslovak national-team results are not duplicated as Czech territorial observations; only localisable/inherited tradition context is used.

uefa-faroe-history.title: UEFA — Faroe Islands association history
uefa-faroe-history.scope: Club, competition, association, artificial-turf and UEFA/FIFA history.

uefa-slovakia-hattrick-review.title: UEFA HatTrick Review 2004–2014 — Slovakia
uefa-slovakia-hattrick-review.scope: 100 mini-pitches, ten full-size artificial pitches and grassroots/access infrastructure in Slovakia.
uefa-slovakia-hattrick-review.limitations: Infrastructure evidence does not directly measure elite competition quality.

uefa-slovakia-history.title: UEFA — Developing football in Slovakia
uefa-slovakia-history.scope: Slovak association timeline, 1969 Slovan European title, 1993/94 international affiliation and modern development strategy.

ussoccer-history-framework.title: U.S. Soccer — History
ussoccer-history-framework.scope: 2003 National Training Center and federation player-development framework.
ussoccer-history-framework.limitations: Federation narrative; does not directly quantify national access or popularity.

ussoccer-timeline.title: U.S. Soccer — Historical timeline
ussoccer-timeline.scope: Federation, competitions, professional-league and major-event history.
ussoccer-timeline.limitations: Chronology is not a quantitative popularity/access series.
